name: n-alkane conformational energy benchmark
description: Provides reference conformational energies for longer n-alkane chains to assess the accuracy of computational methods.
reputation: A specialized benchmark in computational chemistry/materials science used to assess conformational-energy accuracy of quantum-chemical and force-field methods for long n-alkane chains.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; reference energies are computationally expensive (high-level quantum methods). Results sensitive to conformer sampling and basis-set/basis-completeness; dataset size can be modest for very long chains; potential for method-dependent systematic bias.
